ordinary_usd_inputs.working_context: Placement-centred Lambert-93 adjustment chart, stage metres and Z-up; chart zero is the resolved model origin.

limits: Height, attitude and adjustments are illustrative, not surveyed Eiffel Tower placement.
Authored attitude encoding remains under review; the source geographic quaternion illustrates the current candidate.
Panels show mathematical contributions, not prescribed intermediate authoring or an animation of geographic travel.
The CRS is static and uses ellipsoidal height; this does not demonstrate an NGF-IGN69 conversion or an epoch transformation.
The example authors zero as the ordinary pivot in the placement-centred chart; absolute illustration coordinates show the equivalent resolved base.
No finite-extent affine certificate is inferred from the displayed local projection factors.

verification.scope: Figure arithmetic and presentation only; not a proposal-completeness audit or conformance result.

visual_conventions.blue_outline: Exact alpha silhouette of previous mathematical contribution.
visual_conventions.height_guides: Rounded illustrative model height in metres.
visual_conventions.front_markers: Plan-view direction guide; local +Y chosen as model front only for this example.
visual_conventions.translation_components: East and south components of one authored translation, not separately authored operations.
visual_conventions.crs_conversion: Coordinate representation changes; no geographic travel is implied.

crs_association.composition: Reference the CRS definition onto the anchor; no crs:binding relationship.
